# Old Fashioned

<p class="ratio-note">Ratio: 4 parts bourbon to 1 part sweetener</p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof servings = Inputs.range([1, 24], {value: 1, step: 1, label: "Servings"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof sweetener = Inputs.radio(["simple syrup", "maple syrup"], {value: "simple syrup", label: "Sweetener"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fmt = d3.format(".2~f")
bourbon_oz = fmt(servings * 2)
sweetener_oz = fmt(servings * 0.5)
```

### For `{ojs} servings` serving(s)

| Ingredient | Amount |
|---|---|
| Bourbon | `{ojs} bourbon_oz` oz |
| `{ojs} sweetener` | `{ojs} sweetener_oz` oz |
